description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various relational attributes used in the MMRA benchmark, which evaluates multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. The chart is composed of 12 distinct slices, each representing a different attribute with its corresponding count and percentage of the total. The largest segment is ObservationAngle, accounting for 126 instances (12.28%), followed by SimilarMaterial with 106 instances (10.33%), and SubEvent and UsageSimilarity, each with 100 instances (9.74% and 9.65%, respectively). Other attributes include NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%), Layout (90, 8.77%), and Environment (90, 8.77%). Each slice is color-coded and labeled with the attribute name, count, and percentage, with the percentages displayed inside the slices. The slices are arranged in a circular fashion, with no visual emphasis such as explosion or offset, and the chart does not include a separate legend. The distribution shows a relatively even spread across the attributes, with ObservationAngle being the most frequent and NearSameEntity the least frequent.
